scheme_name: Raja Harishachandra Shramik Mratak Antyeshti Sahayata Yojana
other_conditions: The worker must be employed in an establishment registered under the Factories Act, 1948
Monthly basic salary plus dearness allowance must not exceed ₹15,000
Application must be made within one year of the worker’s death
Financial assistance is payable to the worker’s spouse or dependent (son or unmarried daughter)
If the worker was unmarried, assistance can be paid to the mother or father
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹10,000 is provided to the family of a deceased worker.
